title: Genus_Test
label_config:
<View>
  <!-- ============ IMAGE ============ -->
  <Image name="image" value="$image" zoom="true" zoomControl="true" rotateControl="true"/>

  <!-- ============ 1 · BOUNDING BOXES ============ -->
  <Header value="1 · Draw the boxes and ROTATE each one (drag the round handle above the selected box) so its edges line up with the object. "/>
  <Filter toName="label" minlength="0" name="filter"/>
  <RectangleLabels name="label" toName="image">
    <Label value="meter_detection" background="#FFA39E"/>
    <Label value="lcd_detection" background="#FFC069"/>
    <Label value="meter_units" background="#D3F261"/>
  </RectangleLabels>

  <!-- ============ 2 · IMAGE ORIENTATION ============ -->
  <Header value="2 · Image orientation — record the rotation you applied (with the rotate buttons) to view the image upright. Leave on '0' if none."/>
  <Choices name="image_orientation" toName="image" choice="single" showInLine="true">
    <Choice value="0 (none)"/>
    <Choice value="90 (CCW)"/>
    <Choice value="-90 (CW)"/>
    <Choice value="180"/>
    <Choice value="-180"/>
  </Choices>

  <!-- ============ 3 · METER ============ -->
  <Header value="3 · Meter"/>
  <Choices name="meter_visibility" toName="image" choice="single">
    <Choice value="No meter"/>
  </Choices>

  <!-- ============ 4 · LCD ============ -->
  <Header value="4 · LCD"/>
  <Choices name="lcd_visibility" toName="image" choice="single">
    <Choice value="Not visible"/>
  </Choices>

  <!-- ============ 5 · METER READING (value only, no box) ============ -->
  <Header value="5 · Meter reading"/>
  <Choices name="meter_reading_visibility" toName="image" choice="single">
    <Choice value="Not visible"/>
  </Choices>
  <View visibleWhen="choice-unselected" whenTagName="meter_reading_visibility" whenChoiceValue="Not visible">
    <TextArea name="meter_reading_value" toName="image"
              placeholder="e.g. 01234.5" rows="1" maxSubmissions="1"/>
  </View>

  <!-- ============ 6 · METER UNITS (box in section 1 + value here) ============ -->
  <Header value="6 · Meter units"/>
  <Choices name="meter_units_visibility" toName="image" choice="single">
    <Choice value="Not visible"/>
  </Choices>
  <View visibleWhen="choice-unselected" whenTagName="meter_units_visibility" whenChoiceValue="Not visible">
    <TextArea name="meter_units_value" toName="image"
              placeholder="e.g. kWh" rows="1" maxSubmissions="1"/>
  </View>
</View>

title: Genus_Data_for_V2_labeller_1_A
label_config:
<View>
  <Header value="1) Draw a TIGHT box for every visible class.  2) Click a box, then fill its text/label on the right.  3) Set overall readability."/>
  <View style="display:flex">
    <View style="flex:68%">
      <Image name="image" value="$image" zoom="true" zoomControl="true"
             brightnessControl="true" contrastControl="true" rotateControl="false"/>
    </View>
    <View style="flex:32%; padding-left:1em">

      <Header value="Bounding boxes"/>
      <RectangleLabels name="bbox" toName="image" showInline="false">
        <Label value="meter_with_case" background="#7f8c8d"/>
        <Label value="meter_contents"  background="#2ecc71"/>
        <Label value="lcd"             background="#3498db"/>
        <Label value="ROI"             background="#1abc9c"/>
        <Label value="units"           background="#9b59b6"/>
        <Label value="meter_sno"       background="#f39c12"/>
        <Label value="bar_code"        background="#f1c40f"/>
        <Label value="mfg_date"        background="#e74c3c"/>
        <Label value="make_logo"       background="#e67e22"/>
      </RectangleLabels>

      <Header value="Serial  (select the meter_sno box)"/>
      <TextArea name="serial_text" toName="image" perRegion="true"
                whenTagName="bbox" whenLabelValue="meter_sno"
                placeholder="Serial exactly as printed" rows="1" maxSubmissions="1"/>

      <Header value="Manufacture date  (select the mfg_date box)"/>
      <TextArea name="mfg_asprinted" toName="image" perRegion="true"
                whenTagName="bbox" whenLabelValue="mfg_date"
                placeholder="As printed: JAN 2018 / 09/16 / 11/20" rows="1" maxSubmissions="1"/>
      <TextArea name="mfg_normalized" toName="image" perRegion="true"
                whenTagName="bbox" whenLabelValue="mfg_date"
                placeholder="Normalized MM/YYYY, e.g. 01/2018" rows="1" maxSubmissions="1"/>
      <Choices name="mfg_illegible" toName="image" perRegion="true" choice="multiple"
               whenTagName="bbox" whenLabelValue="mfg_date">
        <Choice value="illegible"/>
      </Choices>

      <Header value="Unit  (select the units box)"/>
      <Choices name="unit_class" toName="image" perRegion="true" choice="single"
               whenTagName="bbox" whenLabelValue="units">
        <Choice value="MD"/><Choice value="kW"/><Choice value="kWh"/>
        <Choice value="kVAh"/><Choice value="kVA"/>
      </Choices>

      <Header value="Brand  (select the make_logo box)"/>
      <Choices name="brand" toName="image" perRegion="true" choice="single"
               whenTagName="bbox" whenLabelValue="make_logo">
        <Choice value="(L+G)LandisGyr"/><Choice value="AEW"/><Choice value="AVON"/>
        <Choice value="BENTEC"/><Choice value="Capital"/><Choice value="EPPELTONE"/>
        <Choice value="Genus"/><Choice value="HPL"/><Choice value="INDOTECH"/>
        <Choice value="L&T"/><Choice value="LAN engg ltd."/><Choice value="Maxwell"/>
        <Choice value="Modern Transformers"/><Choice value="PowerTech"/><Choice value="SUNSTAR"/>
        <Choice value="Saame"/><Choice value="Secure"/><Choice value="Visiontek/Linkwell"/>
        <Choice value="OTHERS"/><Choice value="UNREADABLE"/>
      </Choices>
      <TextArea name="brand_other" toName="image" perRegion="true"
                whenTagName="bbox" whenLabelValue="make_logo"
                placeholder="If OTHERS: type the brand name" rows="1" maxSubmissions="1"/>

      <Header value="Reading  (select the ROI box)"/>
      <TextArea name="reading_text" toName="image" perRegion="true"
                whenTagName="bbox" whenLabelValue="ROI"
                placeholder="Digits shown incl. decimal, e.g. 001122.5" rows="1" maxSubmissions="1"/>

      <Header value="Overall readability"/>
      <Choices name="readability" toName="image" choice="single" required="true">
        <Choice value="readable"/><Choice value="partially_readable"/><Choice value="unreadable"/>
      </Choices>

      <Header value="Image problems (optional)"/>
      <Choices name="problems" toName="image" choice="multiple">
        <Choice value="blur"/><Choice value="dark"/><Choice value="glare"/>
        <Choice value="obstructed"/><Choice value="multiple_meters"/><Choice value="unusual"/>
      </Choices>

    </View>
  </View>
</View>
